description: MCP server that audits RAG retrieval — logs what chunks the model saw, scores, queries, and sources before any answer was generated.

features.name: retrieval_observe
features.description: Core capture tool. Called by the agent immediately after a retrieval step. Stores: run_id, query text, retrieved chunks (content + score + source + rank), timestamp, and optional pipeline_tag.

inputs.run_id: string — caller-assigned ID for this retrieval run (e.g. uuid)
inputs.query: string — the exact query sent to the retriever
inputs.chunks: Array<{ content: string; score: number; source: string; rank: number }>

features.name: retrieval_query
features.description: Playback tool. Given a run_id (or pipeline_tag + time range), returns the full retrieval record: query, all chunks with scores, timestamp. Lets an agent answer 'what did I see before I generated that response?'

inputs.run_id: string? — look up a specific run
inputs.limit: number? — max runs to return, default 10

outputs.runs: Array<{ run_id, query, pipeline_tag, timestamp, chunks: Array<{content, score, source, rank}> }>

definition_of_done: npm test passes for F02 suite
npm run inspect lists retrieval_query with correct schema
returns empty array (not error) when no runs match
coverage >= 85% on src/tools/query.ts

features.name: retrieval_diff
features.description: Diff tool. Compares two run_ids and returns: chunks that appeared in run A but not B, chunks in B but not A, score deltas for shared chunks. Useful for 'did my retrieval change after I updated my embeddings?'

inputs.match_by: 'source' | 'content_hash' — how to identify the same chunk across runs

definition_of_done: npm test passes for F03 suite including edge case: identical runs return empty diffs

coverage >= 85% on src/tools/diff.ts

features.name: retrieval_stats
features.description: Stats tool. Aggregates across all stored runs (or filtered by pipeline_tag). Returns: avg top-1 score, score distribution (p50/p90/p99), most-retrieved sources, runs per day. Useful for 'is my retriever getting worse over time?'

inputs.pipeline_tag: string? — filter to a specific pipeline
